annotations.title: Ships near a point or ship

description: Ships heard in the last hour within a radius (at most 50 nautical miles) of a point or of another ship, nearest first. List results are compact rows (mmsi, name, category, flag (ISO code from the MMSI), lat, lon, speed_kn, course_deg, length_m, destination, age_s, status, source); call get_vessel for full details of one ship. Private vessels (pleasure craft, sailing vessels and Class B transponders without a valid IMO number) are never listed or looked up individually; area and nearby results report how many were left out (private_vessels).
